Kelly (People Ops): FYI — we're publishing a short handbook wording change to the 'Hybrid work' section and launching a required 20-min manager microtraining. Please review and RSVP by Apr 12. RSVP + exemption form: https://forms.gle/abc123 :eyes:
Kelly (People Ops): Quick diff preview:
```diff
--- handbook.md
+++ handbook.md
@@ -118,7 +118,9 @@
- Office days are recommended twice monthly.
+ Office days are role-dependent; individual contributors with heavy travel or customer-facing duties may be exempt from a regular office-day requirement.
+ Managers must record approved exemptions in the Work Location field on the team roster.
+ Managers are responsible for communicating schedule changes to their teams.
```
Kelly (People Ops): This is opt-in for ICs (their managers decide). The microtraining is required for all people managers (live or recorded). We'll post the recording and a short FAQ after each session.
James (Eng Mgr): Quick q — are field roles (Field Eng / CS) auto-exempt or do they still need a manager note?
Priya (EM): Also — if recording is allowed, will completion be tracked centrally? Some of my managers travel that week.
Hana (People Ops): Field roles are not "auto-exempt" — exemption needs a manager note on the roster form (we need the reason and dates). Recordings count; we log completion in the compliance tracker (people-ops > Training tab).
Hana (People Ops): Microtraining sessions: M/W/F 10:00 PT through Apr 12. Calendar + sign-ups: https://calendar.company/internal/microtraining. If you can't do live, check the recording link posted under the session.
